title: Nasayem
highlights: 38 m (125 ft) teak-hulled motor yacht built in the UAE in 2011
Twin Caterpillar engines with only around 740 running hours
Seven cabins, including master suites on the upper, main and lower decks
Generous interior volumes and a substantial gross tonnage, ideal for a charter operation
Large saloon, dining hall and covered upper deck lounge
Two crew cabins, watermaker and central air conditioning
Lying at Port Rashid, Dubai, ready for viewing
description:
Nasayem is a 38 m (125 ft) motor yacht built in the United Arab Emirates in 2011, with a teak wood hull and an 8.77 m beam. She is offered for sale in Dubai and lies at Port Rashid.

Her large interior spaces and substantial gross tonnage (GT) set her apart from most yachts of her length: there is room to host big groups in comfort, on several decks. This makes Nasayem an excellent choice for an owner who wants to run her as a charter yacht in Dubai, for private cruises, events or corporate hospitality, as well as for private use.

Power comes from twin 885 hp Caterpillar engines showing only 741 and 733 running hours, backed by two Onan generators (75 kVA and 50 kVA), central air conditioning with two chillers, a watermaker, three battery chargers and three fresh water pumps.

The upper deck combines the wheelhouse, with Northstar GPS, autopilot, hydraulic power steering, VHF and a Thuraya satellite phone, with a master bedroom and a large covered lounge. The main deck offers a saloon with a music system, a dining hall, a pantry, a guest toilet and a second master bedroom, with the galley and crew room forward.

Below, the lower deck has a master bedroom with its own bathroom and four guest cabins, three of them with TV and two with private bathrooms, plus a storeroom with two freezers. Two separate crew cabins with their own air conditioning complete the layout.
